page.layout: One page. A single column of list entries running from top to bottom, each name or "Idem." on the left of a vertical rule and its year on the right. The running head is at the top. The page number is at the top right.

main_text.l: Iohannes Rengers tho Hellen, ex agro. | 1599
Ioannes Rengers them Post, ex agro. | 1608

page.notes: The printed numbers are Arabic years in old-style figures; they are given as printed. "Grüis" is printed with a umlaut over the u; kept as printed. The line "Idem" at the foot stands below the rule with no year beside it. The small marks at the left edge and in the middle of the page are ink spots and are not transcribed. The page number is printed as "xi" in Roman numerals.
